chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) judged regarding the woman widowed from her husband and he had not touched her. He (peace be upon him) said: 'She cannot get married until she observes the waiting period of four months and ten (days), a waiting period of the woman widowed from her husband'.

key_terms.الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا: The woman whose husband has died

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a widow whose husband died before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the widow of a man who died before consummation observes the full waiting period of four months and ten days, as established by Imam Ali (AS), rather than the shorter period for non-consummated marriages. This ruling underscores the continuity of marital status and the dignity of the deceased husband's lineage, even in the absence of physical intimacy. It serves as a foundational precedent in Shia jurisprudence for determining the iddah of widows in cases of pre-death consummation.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding the woman widowed from her husband and he had not touched her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She cannot get married until she observes the waiting period of four months and ten (days), a waiting period of the woman widowed from her husband’.
en.sarwar: 8. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from Muhammad ibn Ziyad from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin issued a judgment about one whose husband had died before going to bed with her, that said, ’She must not marry until her waiting period of four months and ten days is complete, which is the waiting period for one whose husband dies.’”
